scope: Agent-completable isolated-local product, data, authorization, reporting, accessibility, browser and governance controls
correctedDuringAudit: Consultant entitlement could enter the Standard workspace

Qualified-live result digest used non-canonical JSON bytes
Synthetic worker could race the qualified-live dispatcher
Automatic result transition suppressed required focus when the active control was removed

releaseBlockers.detail: All 26 Gate B controls require one named external target, raw evidence, OAuth In production and Security Owner signature.
A production ArtifactObjectReader/object-store binding cannot be selected until the target storage service is named and provisioned. The default remains fail-closed with HTTP 503.
Counsel approval of the reporting notice and version is absent.
Formal PDF accessibility owner decision and native NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver/PDF-UA validation are absent.
Security Owner signature over the exact Gate B result set is absent.
The six production scoring weights lack attributable SME validation. Synthetic qualification remains valid.
